episodes.title: Beware the Beast from Below
episodes.summary: Workers accidentally break into a cave system under Crystal Cove and after that, a strange sewer beast starts putting people into coccoon's with what seems to be frozen yogurt.

episodes.title: The Creeping Creatures
episodes.summary: After a encounter with a fleeing family, the Mystery Machine's engine is stolen. The Scooby gang then holes up at a spooky hotel in the town of Gatorsburg and has encounters with several creepy alligator creatures.

episodes.title: Secret of the Ghost Rig
episodes.summary: The gang have to connect the dots between a ghost truck haunting a highway and the town's recently missing crystal doorknobs. During the investigation, the gang also have to contend with helping Mayor Jones get reelected, and Daphne tries to keep her date with Rung Ladderton a secret from Fred, who couldn't be happier for her when he does find out.

episodes.title: Revenge of the Man Crab
episodes.summary: A Man-Crab attacks Crystal Cove's beach during a volleyball tournament taking the female players.

episodes.title: The Song of Mystery
episodes.summary: Kids are being spookafied by the flute-playing Que Horrifico.

episodes.title: The Legend of Alice May
episodes.summary: A ghost girl is kidnapping boys at school dances, and Fred is her next victim.

episodes.title: In Fear of the Phantom
episodes.summary: The Hex Girls' concert may be canceled after they are threatened by a phantom. Meanwhile, Scooby replaces Shaggy with Harry the puppet as his best friend.

episodes.title: The Grasp of the Gnome
episodes.summary: The gang tries to stop an evil Gnome who doesn't take kindly to people dressed as pirates at Crystal Cove's renaissance fair.

episodes.title: Battle of the Humungonauts
episodes.summary: Two giant monsters named Humungonauts, attack Crystal Cove, causing the gang to spring into action--outfitted with team uniforms made by Fred, much to the disgust of the others.

episodes.title: Howl of the Fright Hound
episodes.summary: A robotic dog terrorizes Crystal Cove and frames Scooby! The gang has to capture the hound and clear Scooby's name.

episodes.title: The Secret Serum
episodes.summary: A vampire is stealing apparently random items, and Daphne suspects her mother is the culprit.

episodes.title: The Shrieking Madness
episodes.summary: Despite splitting up, Mystery Incorporated all end up visiting Darrow University, where the monster Char Gar Gothakon has come to life.

episodes.title: When the Cicada Calls
episodes.summary: Employees of Destroido are being attacked by the Cicada Creature, which can command swarms of the insects.

episodes.title: Mystery Solvers Club State Finals
episodes.summary: When the Mystery Solvers Club State Finals is interrupted by a fiery skeleton-headed specter, Scooby must lead the mascots to save the day.

episodes.title: The Wild Brood
episodes.summary: The "Wild Brood" (a gang of bikers that look like Orcs) comes to Crystal Cove. They seem to be peaceful, but when the Crystal Cove Armory is broken into, the bikers are suspected.

episodes.title: Where Walks Aphrodite
episodes.summary: When Crystal Cove is taken over by Aphrodite's love spell, only Scooby-Doo and the recently escaped Professor Pericles can save the gang from the spell and solve the mystery. Pericles says he can make an antidote, but does he have ulterior motives?

episodes.title: Escape from Mystery Manor
episodes.summary: When the gang investigates the Darrow's old mansion, someone keeps trying to trap them, referring to them by the names of the old Mystery Incorporated members.

episodes.title: The Dragon's Secret
episodes.summary: Exchange student Mai Le comes to Crystal Cove, with a strange ring in her possession. Soon enough, the ring brings the attention of two rival Chinese wizards.

episodes.title: Nightfright
episodes.summary: Shaggy wins a contest to have dinner with the actor Vincent Van Ghoul, but while Shaggy and Scooby visit, four monsters invade the mansion.

episodes.title: The Siren's Song
episodes.summary: After a sardine boat goes missing near a haunted oil platform, Velma follows up an anonymous tip on her own and encounters a singing mermaid.

episodes.title: Menace of the Manticore
episodes.summary: A Manticore terrorizes an amusement park in Crystal Cove.

episodes.title: Attack of the Headless Horror
episodes.summary: After an explorer named Rick Spartan is cursed by a headless monster, the gang must help break it.

episodes.title: A Haunting in Crystal Cove
episodes.summary: Mayor Jones is being haunted in his own home, causing Fred to place his mystery-solving future on the line if he cannot get to the bottom of this haunting.

episodes.title: Dead Justice
episodes.summary: The ghost of Crystal Cove's first sheriff tries to get Sheriff Stone to quit his job.

episodes.title: Pawn of Shadows
episodes.summary: The gang is attacked by a hi-tech assassin Obliteratrix, which leads them to investigate the mystery of the Cursed Treasure with the assistance of H.P. Hatecraft.

episodes.title: All Fear the Freak
episodes.summary: Mystery Incorporated take matters into their own hands, and finds the missing pieces of the Planispheric Disk, discovering what led to the break up of their predecessors.

episodes.title: The Night the Clown Cried
episodes.summary: The Scooby Gang had split apart after discovering that Velma had kept information from them. When a evil man-baby clown torments Crystal Cove, Mystery Inc. figures out how to work out their differences and get on with the mystery.

episodes.title: The House of the Nightmare Witch
episodes.summary: Hot Dog Water becomes "New Daphne" as Mystery Inc. face a haunted house with chicken legs!

episodes.title: The Night the Clown Cried II - Tears of Doom!
episodes.summary: As Crybaby Clown returns, Fred goes to great lengths to get Daphne back.

episodes.title: Web of the Dreamweaver!
episodes.summary: The Dreamweaver has come to life, brainwashing an old group of Crypts and Creatures players (including Sheriff Stone) by entering their minds while they sleep!

episodes.title: The Hodag of Horror
episodes.summary: A wild creature called the Hodag of Horror steals precious jewellery from the people of Crystal Cove. At the same time, Fred's real parents have suddenly appeared, along with a dog whom Scooby has taken a fancy to.

episodes.title: Art of Darkness!
episodes.summary: "Junk", a giant art construction made of vehicular parts, turns its victims into gold statues, but with members of the gang pulled into Randy Warsaw's next piece, it's up to Daphne to solve the case.

episodes.title: The Gathering Gloom
episodes.summary: A zombie ghoul attacks the cemetery, with the prime suspect being the grave digger, Evallo von Meanskrieg, who's a deadringer. But only Velma sees the connection, and has to expose the hoax by herself. Meanwhile, Fred and Shaggy fall in love with three beautiful young immigrants to the silent jealousy of Daphne.

episodes.title: The Night on Haunted Mountain
episodes.summary: After an accident on top of a mountain, the gang discover a flying phantom known as Dark Lilith, terrorizing anyone who approaches nearby.

episodes.title: Grim Judgement
episodes.summary: The Scooby gang encounters a Puritan ghost who is harrassing visitors to the local Lovers Lane.

episodes.title: Night Terrors
episodes.summary: The kids from Mystery Inc. encounter a ghost in a old mansions library after their van is damaged and they have to find a spot to spend the night.

episodes.title: The Midnight Zone
episodes.summary: The Gang search an underwater robot factory, run by Professor Pericles.

episodes.title: Scarebear
episodes.summary: The gang investigates a mysterious mutant bear seen terrorizing Destroido Corp. land.

episodes.title: Wrath of the Krampus
episodes.summary: The juvenile delinquents of Crystal Cove are being attacked by a creature calling itself "Krampus," leaving their hair snow-white with fear.

episodes.title: Heart of Evil
episodes.summary: When a humanoid robotic dragon comes to Crystal Cove, two super-hero vigilantes follow suit.

episodes.title: Theater of the Doomed
episodes.summary: The gang help Vincent Van Ghoul with a play of Crystal Cove's history, which is being haunted by a specter. Meanwhile, Pericles instructs Brad and Judy to steal the Planispheric Disk back from the gang.

episodes.title: Aliens Among Us
episodes.summary: The Crystal Cove sheriff claims that aliens are stealing high-tech devices in order to repair their damaged space ship.

episodes.title: The Horrible Herd
episodes.summary: A herd of mutated skeleton cattle are destroying farms, and heading to destroy all of Crystal Cove.

episodes.title: Dance of the Undead
episodes.summary: A ska group named Rude Boy and the Ska-Tastics come back from the dead and turn people into zombies and make them dance forever!

episodes.title: The Devouring
episodes.summary: A gluten demon tries to consume all of the bread, pasta and tasty treats in Crystal Cove.

episodes.title: Stand and Deliver
episodes.summary: The Dandy Highwayman is assaulting people then abducts the ladies of Crystal Cove with his charming British accent. Meanwhile Scooby is having strange dreams.

episodes.title: The Man in the Mirror
episodes.summary: A man in a mirror kidnaps Fred and takes him to a world where the Planispheric Disk destroyed all of Crystal Cove. Meanwhile the gang encounters a strange Fred.

episodes.title: Nightmare in Red
episodes.summary: When the Freak of Crystal Cove appears in Scooby's nightmares, the gang has to investigate what's going on.

episodes.title: Dark Night of the Hunters
episodes.summary: The gang, accompanied by Velma's mom, goes to Yucatán in search of the Heart of the Jaguar, but are attacked by an ancient Mayan priestess.

episodes.title: Gates of Gloom
episodes.summary: While Mystery Inc. are away, an earthquake sucks down citizens of Crystal Cove beneath the earth!

episodes.title: Through the Curtain
episodes.summary: Using the four keys, the gang find the treasure chamber and the Evil Entity, who reveals a secret that could change their lives forever.

episodes.title: Come Undone
episodes.summary: The lives of Scooby and the gang are in danger when Nibiru comes, threatening reality itself.
